questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in the center of the frame (around 00:08-00:12), exactly three pens are visible.
All three pens are aligned vertically with the black cap/end pointing downwards and the barrel pointing upwards.
All three pens appear identical in color, featuring black caps/ends and translucent greyish barrels.
All pens appear to be capped at the bottom end; no bare writing tips are exposed, and lengths appear uniform.
The board translates smoothly from the left side of the frame to the right side without pausing or reversing.

parsed.reason: The board carries three identical, correctly oriented pens and moves smoothly across the frame, satisfying all nominal conditions.
